ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Funding Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind the deferment of $91 million in Medicaid funding and potential fraud within Minnesota's Medicaid program.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover potential fraud and misuse of Medicaid funds
questions: What are the specific allegations of fraud?
How widespread is the issue within Minnesota's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover significant fraud within Minnesota's Medicaid program and potentially lead to further investigations and policy changes.

ideas.title: The Aimee Bock and Feeding Our Future Documents Leak Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding Aimee Bock's repeated leaks of Feeding Our Future documents and potential implications for the organization.
ideas.angle: Internal controls and governance issues within Feeding Our Future
questions: What are the specific documents leaked?
What are the implications for Feeding Our Future's governance?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal internal controls issues within Feeding Our Future and potentially lead to further investigations into the organization's governance.
